performance.verdict: No paid channel active; organic eroding fast in a prove-it month.

findings.text: OVERDUE: Phone-match attribution gap (due 2026-08-07) still open — zero paid leads tracked despite 60 GBP calls in 28 days; scoreboard is blind.
OVERDUE: Sync items and contact cleanup (due 2026-08-14) not marked done — 92 opps created, 0 won, 0 appointments in GHL; pipeline integrity unverifiable.
Zero paid spend across all 28 days; Meta and Google both $0. No efficiency metric is computable — the paid channel simply does not exist right now.

GBP actions collapsed from ~17/day (Aug 14–19 peak: 25–26) to 0 on Aug 27–28 — 3-day signal (Aug 26–28: 7, 0, 0) vs prior 3 (Aug 23–25: 6, 1, 0) confirms sharp trailing drop; -76.47% 7d delta is real.

GA4 sessions dropped -43.97% week-over-week; last 3 days (Aug 26–28: 14, 11, 4) vs prior 3 (Aug 23–25: 6, 9, 14) are volatile but the Aug 28 value of 4 is the series low, suggesting a real site-traffic fade with no paid support.

suggestions.text: Close phone-match attribution gap immediately — 60 GBP calls in 28 days are invisible to the scoreboard.
suggestions.monday_update: The phone-match attribution gap (due 2026-08-07) is still open. In a prove-it month, 60 GBP calls over 28 days that cannot be attributed to Full Smile's scoreboard make the entire engagement unmeasurable. Attribution team must complete the GHL call-source tagging fix this week. Success: every inbound call from GBP and paid sources appears with a trackable source in GHL by 2026-09-05.

suggestions.text: Verify sync/contact cleanup completion — 92 opps, 0 appointments, 0 won in GHL signals intake leak, not ads problem.
suggestions.monday_update: The sync and contact cleanup milestone (due 2026-08-14) has no confirmed completion event. GHL shows 92 opportunities created but 0 appointments and 0 won in the 28-day window, which either means the pipeline is broken or leads are not being worked. CRM team must confirm cleanup status and audit whether opportunities are progressing to appointments. Success: at least 1 confirmed appointment appearing in GHL within 7 days, confirming intake is functional by 2026-09-05.

suggestions.text: Watch GBP for a third consecutive zero-action day; if confirmed, escalate organic visibility review before any paid relaunch.
suggestions.monday_update: GBP actions hit 0 on both Aug 27 and Aug 28, following a 25-action peak on Aug 19. With zero paid spend amplifying any organic dip, a third consecutive zero would confirm a visibility problem, not just noise. Monitor GBP actions daily through 2026-08-31. If Aug 29 also reads 0, escalate to SEO/GBP team for an immediate profile audit before any paid budget is re-activated. Re-check 2026-09-01.
